title: MoLoRA per-token physical specialist-bank compression
hypothesis: At fixed original per-token router, a shared specialist m bank preserves at least 99% of native mixed-skill quality or <=1 percentage point drop (use stricter relevant threshold), reduces total specialist+router serialized inference bytes >=15% and P95 decode latency <=1.10 native, while beating a byte-matched ordinary SVD bank and identifying all prefix-cache incompatibilities.
physical_object: frozen MoLoRA per-token router and independently trained LoRA specialist bank
mirror_coordinate: small per-expert Mirror m decoding one shared LoRA update basis only on tokens routed to its expert
native_control: MoLoRA independent-LoRA per-token routing and native cached-prefix semantics
controls: original MoLoRA router with independent LoRAs
MoLoRA router with SVD-compressed adapter bank at matched total bytes
MoLoRA with native task-group shared LoRA
reference target-adapter re-prefill and cache-copy controls

screen.fixture: Toy 2-layer d=64 causal Transformer, 4 separate specialists and 4-skill token streams with heldout combinations/switches; native MoLoRA official benchmark later if available. Source banks can be aligned or independently trained, evaluated separately.
steps: Freeze base revision, specialist training data, token routing and MoLoRA original top-k semantics.
Train four native per-token LoRA experts, split whole task/domain identities into source/dev/fresh.
Construct plain shared linear factor bank and signed/orthogonal m bank at matched bytes; do not fit heldout oracle deltas.
Run same frozen learned token router on all methods; never give audit task ID or oracle route.
Verify target-native fresh prefix on each switched token path; explicit safe alias vs copied or upstream-different invalid state.
Measure mixed-domain token loss, per-task quality, physical cache bytes, adapter-bank serialized size, router MAC/FLOP and batch P95.
screen.hardware: CPU torch float32 synthetic; optionally CUDA GPU with kernel details, true token routing, B=1/8 context=128/512, GPU clock and synchronized P95.

gates.PASS: At least 4 of 5 fresh worlds quality >=0.99 native and <=1pp absolute decline when native near chance, total incremental bytes <=0.85 native, P95 <=1.10 native, no cache provenance violations, with strict benefit over same-byte ordinary factorization.
gates.FAIL: Native compressed bank dominates m, router includes audit labels, incompatible prefix reuse called exact, or hidden re-prefill overhead eliminates runtime savings.
gates.UNCERTAIN: Missing native reproduction or physical bytes/timing and fresh task evidence
